scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Hello! Do you need some Q-Pet food?
Or maybe some accessories to decorate your Q-Pet?
There is also a Q-Pet taming item!
scripts.translation:
[宠物美容师]
您好！需要购买宠物饲料吗？
或者需要一些饰品来装饰您的宠物？
这里还有宠物驯服道具哦！

scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Okay, please buy it yourself.
scripts.translation:
[宠物美容师]
好的，请您自己购买吧。

[宠物美容师]
好的，那我们进行交换吧。

scripts.text:
[Pet Groomer]
Okay, come back whenever you want.
scripts.translation:
[宠物美容师]
好的，您随时都可以回来。
